name: kaleido-video
description: Remotion compositions for Kaleido launch and announcement videos. Kept out of the Next app's dependency tree on purpose — see README.md.

scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render LaunchWide out/kaleido-private-beta-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:square: npm run audio && remotion render LaunchSquare out/kaleido-private-beta-1x1.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run audio && remotion render LaunchVertical out/kaleido-private-beta-9x16.mp4
